    {"name": "off_hours_open", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Off-hours flag is directly derivable from opened_at timestamps and is a legitimate operational-burden axis affecting resolution duration.   ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.72,
  "source_groundedness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "Most added columns provide genuine, distinct axes (category, symptom, locus, scope, off-hours) for isolating common operational burdens and modeling their effect on resolution duration, which is exactly what the query needs. incident_category, failure_symptom_type, and off_hours_open are both useful and well-grounded. scope_indicator and reassigned_resolver are useful but rest partly on inference not clearly supported by the visible text. recurring_caller_pattern is near-constant and poorly grounded, dragging the table down. Overall the set is analytically leveraged and largely grounded, with a few inference-heavy or degenerate columns."
